purpose: Discovery catalogue for current Human Record entries. This is routing metadata, not a universal record schema, evidence upgrade or certification surface.
view_basis_policy: Each human view is a derived reading surface. source_git_blobs identify the exact Markdown/JSON record bytes the view was aligned to. If either underlying source blob changes without a corresponding view-basis update, view freshness is unestablished. A blob match establishes byte identity, not truth.

records.title: Winslow Homer, Camp Fire (1880)
records.known_summary: The Human Record reconciled eight identity fields against The Metropolitan Museum of Art public record and observed byte-identical museum/PSFH image streams at the recorded time.
records.unknown_summary: Custody before 1927, independent proof of the 1880 creation event, and usefulness for contemporary human/synthetic ambiguity remain unestablished.

records.title: The '80% of German flak crews died' claim
records.known_summary: A visible online propagation chain is partially reconstructed; downstream repetition is not independent corroboration and checked nearby historical sources do not establish the claimed aggregate German crew mortality rate.
records.unknown_summary: The true rate, any earlier source for the 80% figure, and the figure's exact ancestry remain unknown in this record.

records.title: Sieve and riddle making returns from extinction
records.known_summary: Public sources show a reported last maker, a later extinction classification, Red List/media attention and renewed practice; Heritage Crafts currently reports the craft as critically endangered.
records.unknown_summary: What was transmitted, what was reconstructed or newly learned, and through which routes remain only partly visible.
records.strongest_owner: Heritage Crafts for current UK craft status and safeguarding.
records.consent_boundary: Public-source lineage only; named living practitioners were not contacted and no endorsement or private/tacit process material is claimed.
